effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] For each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash any 1 digivolution card from your opponent's Digimon and suspend 1 of their Digimon. Then, this Digimon may attack.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, it gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) for the turn and unsuspends.
